mechanism: Chlorpromazine may potentiate the hypotensive effects of irbesartan through additive vasodilation and CNS depression, while irbesartan may increase chlorpromazine levels via CYP3A4/CYP2C9 competition.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly and counsel patients on orthostatic precautions; adjust irbesartan dose if hypotension develops, and monitor for increased chlorpromazine adverse effects.
